about.name: About me
about.title: The old oak
about.body: Frontend developer. React, Next.js and TypeScript - interfaces that feel effortless, ship quickly and hold up in production. The bench under the canopy is where the long problems get solved.

contact.body: Flag up, door open. Have a project, a role or just a question? I usually reply within a day.
